audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup's core plan is inverted. Four strings say his passive heals off LOW-HP TARGETS — 'his passive heal only ramps on low-HP targets', 'E-block his autos so his low-HP passive heal never triggers — if he can't drop you below the threshold, his sustain does nothing', 'deny him the low-HP target his passive needs to heal', 'before his passive heal scales on low-HP targets'.
audit.why: Riot: 'Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If WARWICK is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.' The trigger is his own health, not yours. So the page's central instruction — stay healthy and his sustain does nothing — is exactly wrong: what actually matters is that a wounded Warwick heals more, so a trade you break off at his 30% health is the worst possible outcome. Blood Hunt is the ability that reads YOUR health (below 50% he gains move speed toward you), and the entry never says so.
audit.corrected: Eternal Hunger described by its real trigger in early, mid, whys[0], whys[3], whys[6], spikes[0], wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0]; Blood Hunt's 'your health' rule added to mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl is never named and its fear is never mentioned, while the page tells you to 'E-block' Warwick's all-in.
audit.why: Primal Howl gives him 2.5 seconds of damage reduction and then a 1-second fear. A fear is crowd control and Aegis Assault is a channel, so holding the shield into his howl loses it. The _missing-interactions file flags Primal Howl for exactly this pairing.
audit.corrected: Named with its 15s and its fear in early, mid, whys[2] and spikes[1]; the 'E-block it' instruction removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Infinite Duress can be cancelled, and dosFull tells you to 'Bait or E-block it'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a channelled suppression of 1.5 seconds. Shield Vault is a 600-range point-click stun that ends channels — this is the single highest-value play available to Pantheon in the matchup, and _missing-interactions flags it. Meanwhile 'E-block it' is wrong twice over: a suppression cancels your channel, and Aegis Assault only covers your front.

edits.before: Warwick is a non-threat at levels 1-3 — his passive heal only ramps on low-HP targets and his Q sustain hasn't scaled yet, so this is pure free real estate for you. Open with the point-and-click W-stun and a tapped Q at level 1, then look for the level-2 W+Q all-in the instant you hit it. At level 3 lead with E to block his auto DPS while you W-stun in and land an empowered-Q — he has no dash to escape and no sustain yet to win the race.
edits.after: Warwick is a non-threat at levels 1-3 — Jaws of the Beast has not scaled and Eternal Hunger only heals him while HE is below 50% health, so a healthy Warwick sustains nothing at all. Open with the point-and-click Shield Vault and a tapped Comet Spear at level 1, then take the level-2 W+Q all-in the instant you hit it. At 3 he still has no dash. Primal Howl (E, 15s at rank 1) is the one to respect: it ends in a fear.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are still yours: keep your empowered-Q poke up and E-block his autos so his low-HP passive heal never triggers — if he can't drop you below the threshold, his sustain does nothing. His W gives chase move speed and his Q heals, so don't drag trades out; go for short, decisive W-stun burst windows. At 6 his R is a suppress-lock all-in tool, so respect it, but your own R is for roams — use Grand Starfall to snowball other lanes rather than fishing for a risky 1v1.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are still yours: keep empowered-Q poke up and finish trades quickly, because Eternal Hunger triples its healing once HE drops under 25%. Blood Hunt is the mirror of that — it reads YOUR health, giving him speed toward you below 50%, so don't idle at half HP. Primal Howl gives 2.5 seconds of damage reduction then a fear that cancels Aegis Assault. At 6, Infinite Duress is a channel: a timed Shield Vault cancels it outright.

notes: This entry's whole gameplan is built on an inverted passive. Four strings tell the player that Eternal Hunger heals Warwick off LOW-HEALTH TARGETS, and therefore that staying healthy switches his sustain off — 'if he can't drop you below the threshold, his sustain does nothing'. Riot's text is the reverse: Warwick heals when HE is below 50% health, tripled below 25%. So the advice actively misleads. What is true, and what the page never says, is that a half-finished trade is the dangerous one: a wounded Warwick heals more, not less. Blood Hunt is the ability keyed to YOUR health — below 50% he gains move speed toward you — and it is 80 seconds at rank 1. Second, Primal Howl appears nowhere despite being the ability that beats Pantheon's E: 2.5 seconds of damage reduction ending in a 1-second fear, which cancels the Aegis Assault channel. Third, and best for the player: Infinite Duress is a channelled suppression, so a 600-range Shield Vault cancels a 110-second ultimate outright. The page instead advised 'bait or E-block it', which cannot work — a suppression ends the channel and the block only faces one way. The packet's 'no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' flag is now addressed with Primal Howl's 15s as the trade clock.
